resources.string: Explicit T1/T2 draft edits only. Catalog choices below are synthetic fixtures. These controls do not evaluate compatibility, cost, deployment requirements or readiness. Save or explicitly reopen pending form edits before changing components.
This retained kind is outside the current T1/T2 editor. Its content remains unchanged.
Commit the enabled state for this exact selection? Settings and links remain retained. This does not establish that its requirements are met.
Remove this exact selection and its incident links? No other selection is promoted or removed. Affected link IDs (0 means none): %1$s
Replace this selection with exact fixture %1$s @ %2$s from snapshot %3$s? Its identity, role, enabled state, settings and links are retained. Compatibility is not established.

Add exact fixture %1$s @ %2$s from snapshot %3$s. Enter an explicit lowercase role and schema-valid settings. Empty settings provide no missing required values. The checkbox below is the exact enabled state to commit.

Replace only this selection’s settings with the exact JSON object below. Required settings must remain present. Raw credentials must never be entered; only opaque secret references are allowed where the frozen schema permits them. Invalid input remains visible and does not save.
No revision committed. Enter an explicit schema-valid role and settings object within the editor limit. Invalid raw input is retained in the open form.
No revision committed. Selection command rejected: %1$s. Reopen or revise the explicit choice; no substitute was selected.
Local selection revision saved. Compatibility, cost and readiness remain unestablished.
The current saved selection already matches. No new revision was created.
Existing settings exceed this small editor’s text limit. They remain saved unchanged; this editor will not truncate them.
